summary: Iteration 53: Broker OAuth 2.0 Infrastructure & Historical Sentiment Tracking Testing Complete. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified BrokerConnect OAuth status handling, SectorHeatmap AI tab with sparkline trends, and URL parameter handling for OAuth callbacks.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/broker/oauth/alpaca/status correctly returns available:false, configured:false when ALPACA_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID is not set
GET /api/broker/oauth/kraken/status correctly returns available:false with reason 'OAuth not supported for this broker'
GET /api/sectors/sentiment/history returns proper structure with snapshots_count, sector_trends, latest_rotation_call, latest_risk_regime
GET /api/sectors/sentiment/history?limit=5 correctly respects the limit parameter
BrokerConnect.jsx correctly hides OAuth button when OAuth is not configured (no client ID)
BrokerConnect.jsx shows manual API key inputs with Paper Trading toggle for Alpaca
SectorHeatmap.jsx AI tab shows Multi-Agent Consensus header with 4 agents badge and risk regime
SectorHeatmap.jsx displays sparkline SVGs for each sector when history has 2+ snapshots
URL parameter ?broker_connected=alpaca triggers success message and auto-opens broker modal
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 53 verified NEW broker OAuth 2.0 infrastructure and historical sentiment tracking. Key findings: (1) GET /api/broker/oauth/{broker_id}/status returns OAuth availability - alpaca returns available:false (no client ID configured), kraken returns 'not supported', (2) GET /api/sectors/sentiment/history returns snapshots_count, sector_trends with timestamp/score/heatmap_value/label per sector, latest_rotation_call, latest_risk_regime, (3) Frontend BrokerConnect.jsx correctly hides OAuth button when not configured, shows manual API key form, (4) SectorHeatmap.jsx AI tab shows Multi-Agent Consensus with 4 agents badge, mixed risk regime, 4 snapshots badge, sparkline trends for each sector, (5) URL param ?broker_connected=alpaca triggers success message 'Successfully connected alpaca via OAuth!' and auto-opens modal, (6) All 8 brokers displayed: Alpaca (recommended), Charles Schwab, Interactive Brokers, MooMoo, Webull, Robinhood, Public.com, Kraken.
